fullDesc: On June 25, 1876 Lakota Sioux and Cheyenne warriors led by Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse wiped out part of the US 7th Cavalry under George Armstrong Custer. It was the Plains Indians' greatest victory, but the US Army soon forced them onto reservations.
realFacts: Custer and over 200 of his men died
The fight began over the Black Hills gold rush
